name: Sample Pages 7 — Resume Builder (Editor)
source: User-provided screenshot export from Figma (Sample Full-Screen Modal Builder - 1). Node ID not captured.
description: Resume Builder opened as a full-screen modal (Browser type: plain white chrome). Header: 'Resume Builder' title + close X. Mode toolbar: Editor/Design tab switch left, Save Template split button + Download button right. Body: left editor sidebar (ResumeBuilderPanel Home view with Displayed/Hidden section lists) and right preview canvas on surface-strong showing the rendered resume document.

shell.note: Full-screen modal overlays the entire viewport — sidebar and app-bar are covered. Modal chrome is the page shell.

modal-header.description: Modal title bar: 'Resume Builder' (text-styles.bold.body-lg, system.text-head) left, close X icon button right.

mode-toolbar.description: Toolbar under the header. Left: mode switch tabs (Basic style, icon + text): 'Editor' (pencil icon, active) and 'Design' (typography icon, inactive/disabled until content valid). Right: 'Save Template' split button (Outlined, with chevron dropdown) + 'Download' button (Filled).

builder-body.description: Two-column builder body. Left: 330px editor sidebar. Right: preview canvas.

editor-sidebar.description: Resume section manager. Group header row 'Displayed' with count chip (4) on system.surface-strong strip; section rows (Personal Information, Formal Education, Working Experience, Additional Information) each with leading section icon, eye toggle (brand.brand) and chevron. Group 'Hidden' with count chip (3): Course, Skill, Achievement rows with eye-off toggle (system.text-mute). Bottom: helper card with character illustration + caption 'Easily customize your resume...' (text-styles.regular.body-sm, system.text-body).

helper-illustration.note: Mascot illustration in the bottom helper card

preview-canvas.description: Scrollable preview area showing the rendered resume as an A4 page card centered on a tinted canvas. Vertical scroll bar at the right edge.

content.note: White A4 page card (corner-radius.none paper look with shadow): avatar top-left; right column of icon+text personal info rows; sections 'Social Profile', 'Profile Summary', 'About Me' with title (text-styles.bold.body-lg) + divider + body text (text-styles.regular.body-sm)

customElementsRegistry.builder-mode-toolbar: Basic icon+text tabs (Editor/Design) left; Save Template split button + Download filled button right. Border-bottom: system.border-soft.
customElementsRegistry.builder-body: Two-column: 330px editor sidebar (resume-builder-panel) + preview canvas on system.surface-strong with document-gallery page card.

geometry.modal: fullscreen browser EModal, plain white chrome, title Resume Builder + close X

toolbar.left: segmented Editor/Design switch (gray container, active seg white)
toolbar.right: Save Template Tonal split button + Download Filled (no icon)

sidebar.rows: borderless, icon + label + brand eye / mute eye-off + chevron

footer.copy: Easily customize your resume. Choose which sections to display or hide, and save your personalized version as a PDF.

canvas.background: #dbeafe (rgb 219,234,254; token gap - no brand surface-medium token)

paper.note: true A4 at 72dpi, measured x=1191..2381 physical
